Class ColorChoosingPhase

java.lang.Object
model.phaseHandlers.ColorChoosingPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhaseHandler, GameCommandVisitor
public class ColorChoosingPhase extends Object implements GamePhaseHandler
Handles the preliminary phase of the game where players select their representative totem colors before the match officially begins.

This handler is responsible for the following lifecycle:

  1. Initializing the pool of available TotemColors.
  2. Starting an asynchronous 60-second countdown timer.
  3. Processing incoming ChooseColorCommands via double-dispatch to validate and assign colors dynamically.
  4. Automatically advancing the state machine to the SetupPhase once all players have successfully locked in a color.
  5. Applying a fallback mechanism if the timeout expires, automatically assigning random remaining colors to any inactive players to prevent server deadlocks.

Command dispatch utilizes the Visitor pattern to intercept client requests, ensuring robust validation against duplicate choices or late submissions.

    • onEnter

      public void onEnter()
      Initializes the state of the phase by populating the available color pool and launching an asynchronous watchdog timer.

      Timeout Behavior: If the 60-second timer expires before all players have chosen, a background thread forces random assignments for the remaining players and subsequently updates the model.

    • doChooseColor

      private void doChooseColor(Player player, TotemColor color)
      Executes the core transactional logic of assigning a color to a player.

      This method removes the selected color from the available pool and notifies observers of the state mutation. If this assignment fulfills the requirement that all players have a color, it halts the timeout execution and transitions the game into the SetupPhase.

      Parameters:
      player - the player receiving the color assignment.
      color - the specific TotemColor being assigned.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the requested color is already taken by another player.
